node.statement: Conditional structure-theorem application. Apply lem-thmainext-conditional with epsilon=epsilon_AI(eta) to the same finite-dimensional extended epsilon_AI(eta)-C*-algebra A, using 0<=epsilon_AI(eta)<=epsilon_E. It supplies a finite-dimensional C*-algebra B and one extended C_E*epsilon_AI(eta)-isomorphism v:B->A. A finite-dimensional C*-algebra is unital, so B has the required finite-dimensional unital C*-algebra type.
